non_claims: Sulfation site (aryl, vinyl or alkyl) and position are not resolved.
The desulfated parent is not claimed: the scaffold list only gates the precursor m/z.

notes: measure:false, provisional (WS0 2026-11-19, pending the author): the SO3 radical anion is HSO4- minus OH, so HSO4- with the SO3 radical anion is one parent-daughter channel; the SO3 loss with HSO4- would be two ions.

competitors.note: Lafaye 2004 reports that sulfonic acids such as taurine-conjugated bile acids do not share the sulfate CID pattern (data not shown).
N-sulfates give an N-specific ion in place of the SO3 radical anion in the one pair reported.
H2PO4- and the HPO3 loss sit 9.5 mDa from HSO4- and the SO3 loss; the p2 product tolerance and the observed-precursor loss reference keep them apart.

priors.note: Only mono-sulfate [M-H]- hypotheses are tried: bis-sulfates ionise mainly as [M-2H]2-, a charge state outside the v1 format.
